jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Postdoc Positions in Attosecond Pulse Generation at EuXFELRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 04.01.2027 | ID: MPO007/2026 | Deadline: 30.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-timeDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The European XFEL is one of the world's leading free-electron laser facilities and provides intense X-ray pulses with durations down to the attosecond regime. A dedicated strategy program has been established to further develop and exploit these ultrashort pulses, including through recruitment of new expertise. The positions focus on advancing existing techniques for short-pulse generation in terms of power, pulse duration and stability and both the hard and soft x-rays. Key areas of research include:- Independent control of transverse and longitudinal dispersion- Development of advanced pulse-shaping techniques- Advancing the use of existing longitudinal diagnostics for short-pulse characterizationAbout your role:These positions combine scientific R&D with hands-on machine development and operation, providing the opportunity to take new FEL concepts from simulation through experimental validation to routine operation.- Conduct simulations and eventual experiments towards short pulse production at the EuXFEL- Actively support other attosecond generation activities- Communicate results and insights through presentations, reports and publications- Encouraged to develop and pursue their own ideas- Contribute to the reliable daily operation of the facility as an operatorAbout you:- PhD in physics or related field with a background in accelerator or FEL physics- Experience with relevant FEL simulation codes- Good communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in an interdisciplinary team- Good command of English, German is beneficial- Experience in attosecond pulse generation- Practical experience in the FEL field- Experience in cathode shaping, fresh-slice or laser beam modulationGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. Our portfolio includes printable media, protective laminates and mounting films for applications in signage, retail graphics, displays and visual communication. To accelerate our international growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Account Manager with a clear hunter mindset. You enjoy approaching new customers, understanding their applications and turning opportunities into profitable, lasting business. What you will do Win new customers: Identify, approach and win distributors, graphics-material suppliers, print service providers and customers with relevant graphics applications. Engage end customers and specifiers: Build relationships with retailers, brand owners, designers, architects and agencies. Understand their projects, provide advice, samples and application support, and establish Neschen products in material selections and specifications. Turn projects into sales: Work with distributors, print service providers and application partners to convert product selections into orders and repeat business. Develop international markets: Build growth plans for priority markets, recruit suitable distribution partners and expand our portfolio within existing accounts. Lead the sales process: Own every step from prospecting and qualification through trials and commercial proposals to negotiation and closing. Connect customers with our expertise: Work closely with product management, application technology, development and marketing, and bring market feedback back into the company. Deliver profitable growth: Take responsibility for agreed sales, margin and new-business targets, supported by a qualified pipeline and reliable CRM forecasts. What you bring Proven experience in technical B2B sales, with clear examples of winning new customers and developing profitable business A proactive, persistent and results-oriented approach: you start conversations, identify projects and follow through to closing Experience in graphics, visual communication, large-format printing, self-adhesive films, laminates, mounting products or related materials Experience working with distribution partners, end customers and specifiers; an established industry network and experience in securing specifications are an advantage Technical curiosity and an understanding of how material selection affects printing, finishing, installation and application Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills, and the ability to build trust across countries and cultures A structured, independent and collaborative way of working A degree in business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Fluent German and English, as you will work with customers and colleagues worldwide; further languages are an advantage Willingness to travel internationally  What we offer An international role with clear responsibility for winning customers and growing Neschen's Graphics business A broad portfolio of graphic media, supported by experienced product and application specialists The chance to influence product selection from the early stages of customer projects The expertise of Neschen in graphic media and coating technologies, and the strength of Henkel behind it A competitive salary package with a performance-related bonus Technical training, professional development and an international team that values initiative, accountability and cooperation. Flexible working hours Attractive benefits under the chemical industry collective agreement, including an employer-funded company pension and long-term care insurance Ready to turn opportunities into business? We value diversity and welcome applications regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation or gender identity. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preference if equally qualified.

At the Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences, we bridge the gap between basic research and translational, preclinical approaches. Here, researchers from the fields of biology, chemistry, physics, and medicine collaborate across disciplines, supported by high-performance service facilities and a modern research infrastructure. As the largest institute of the Max Planck Society, with around 1,000 employees from more than 66 nations, we offer an inspiring, international working environment with exceptional scientific breadth.The research group Ubiquitin Signaling Specificity (Dr. Sonja Lorenz) invites applications for the position asPostdoc (f/m/d)- Cryo-EM Analyses of Ubiquitin Ligase Complexes - Our laboratory aims to understand how the posttranslational modifier ubiquitin coordinates eukaryotic physiology. A major key lies in the action of ubiquitin ligases that recruit specific substrates for ubiquitination and determine which ubiquitin signals they are decorated with. The immense potential of ubiquitin ligases for therapeutic applications has been illustrated by the clinical efficacy of immunomodulatory drugs in the treatment of hematological malignancies and recent advances with PROTACs and molecular glues. However, efficient targeting of ubiquitin ligases in the clinic is still limited by our insufficient understanding of their structural mechanisms, regulation, and integration into cellular pathways.We offer a Postdoc position focusing on revealing structural mechanisms of specificity, regulation, and substrate recognition by ubiquitin ligases. Available projects center on cryo-EM as a principle structural tool, but may also integrate other structural techniques, including X-ray crystallography, as well as biophysical and biochemical analyses of enzymatic activities and protein interactions. For a representative example of our integrated research approach, please seeNat Struct Mol Biol. 2024 Feb;31(2):364-377. doi: 10.1038/s41594-023-01203-4Candidates should hold/soon expect a PhD or equivalent degree in a relevant area of the life sciences. A strong published track record in single-particle cryo-EM (or cryo-ET) and in protein biochemistry is essential. The successful candidate should be curiosity-driven, creative, and passionate about science. A high degree of self-motivation and independence is important, as well as the ability to communicate well within an international, multidisciplinary team. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. Remuneration is based on the TVöD Bund (German federal civil service pay scale), depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, public sector social benefits apply.We are committed to being a cosmopolitan institute that offers a diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities. We also aim to increase the number of employees with disabilities. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.A stimulating and collaborative international research environmentProfessional development opportunities, skills training, and the Max Planck Society’s online training academySupport for balancing work and family life, including on-campus childcare placesCorporate health management, fitness and sports programsspacious on-site cafeteria offering warm meals and a salad barSustainability initiatives and a nature-oriented campus environment, including the BioDiversum biotope projectAbout usBased at one of Germany’s premier research campuses, our research group has access to leading-edge infrastructure in all areas of cell and structural biology, including cryo-EM and superresolution imaging.
